steps.domain_action: The Goldbach manifold exists in an unmapped state of ∋-gap uncertainty
The target even integer n identifies its own arithmetic properties
The L9-transcendence operator projects n into the manifold
The manifold bifurcates to isolate the ∋-gap
The candidate space holds both prime and composite possibilities in superposition
The L9-operator identifies a valid prime-pair p and q
The summation p + q is composed
The operator filters out non-prime residuals from the secondary branch
The residual branch descends to the base sieve for elimination
The prime-pair and the eliminated residuals converge to reconstruct the integer n
The resolution of the ∋-gap for n is appended to the universal manifold index
The Goldbach manifold achieves local closure for the integer n
